measurement_scope: synthetic fine-tune inference; stud box is the minimal OBB of points labeled stud

scene.name: s1_2x4_lean1.000_ax+Y
scene.reference_meaning: Stage 0 has no floor. The generator +Z axis is the angle reference. The cloud is not rotated.
scene.description: Phase 1 S1 synthetic dressed stud. Lean 1.000 deg about +Y. Long axis is +Z before the right-hand rotation. Generator gravity is +Z. No floor. The cloud is not rotated.

meta.init: BIMStruct3D PT-v3m1 backbone, new 2-class MLP head

implementation_short: PTv3 backbone plus a 2-class head, minimal OBB on stud points.

detection.note: 25666 points labeled stud (class 1) of 25666. A box is fit when that count is at least 50. Counts are this synthetic scene, not a field accuracy.

geometry.note: Section and length are the minimal OBB of the stud-labeled points versus the dressed generator stud. Same box as the classical finders.

angle.band_meaning: Percent of matched studs whose |measured - synthetic truth| is within the working tolerance.
angle.note: Truth is the generator lean against +Z. Not a SKIL reading.

paint.production_rule: epsilon unlocked, so every stud is yellow
paint.hypothetical_placeholder_note: 0.05 deg is a round illustration of the color rule. It is not a measured device band.
paint.note: Do not read hypothetical colors as a pass/fail call.

cost.license: MIT code; BIMStruct3D weights CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, not committed
failure_modes: Trained on synthetic dressed studs and a floor slab only.
Color features are zeros. Normals are estimated.
A real scan was not used.
CC BY-NC-SA base weights are not a commercial stud model.
cost.note: Runtime is this inference on this scene, after weights were already loaded.

notes: Synthetic stage 0 only. Not a field measurement. Device epsilon is unlocked, so production paint is yellow.
